class.name: CgameNetSchema
class.brief_description: Describes replicated entity fields and serializes state to compact, delta-coded packets.

method.name: bits_for_range
method.description: Returns the number of bits needed to store every integer from [param min_value] to [param max_value].

method.name: deserialize
method.description: Decodes [param bytes] on top of a shallow copy of [param baseline]. Fields absent from the packet keep their baseline value. Truncated packets decode missing bits as zero.

method.name: deserialize_versioned
method.description: Decodes a packet from [method serialize_versioned]. Returns [code]{"ok": bool, "state": Dictionary}[/code]; [code]ok[/code] is [code]false[/code] and [code]state[/code] empty when the packet is shorter than four bytes or its schema hash does not match.

method.name: get_field_count
method.description: Returns the number of fields in the current schema.

method.name: get_schema
method.description: Returns the normalized schema (all keys filled in).

method.name: get_schema_hash
method.description: Returns a 32-bit hash of the schema (names, types, bits, ranges and conditions) for version checks.

method.name: serialize
method.description: Encodes [param state] relative to [param baseline] according to the field conditions. Pass an empty baseline for a full snapshot. Fields missing from [param state] are never sent.

method.name: serialize_versioned
method.description: Like [method serialize] but prefixed with the little-endian 32-bit schema hash.

method.name: set_schema
method.description: Replaces the schema. Returns [code]false[/code] (leaving an empty schema and printing an error) if [code]fields[/code] is missing or a field has an unknown type or condition. Missing [code]bits[/code], [code]min[/code], [code]max[/code] default to [code]0[/code] and [code]condition[/code] to [code]"on_change"[/code].
